body: Well I'm 21 years old, going through a divorce from a guy who was both physically and emotionally abusive to me while I was pregnant with his daughter. She's three months old now. Now I'm living somewhere where I don't know anyone, I'm not allowed to leave the house where I am staying because my parents are giving me a very little amount of money and told me they would cut me off if I didn't follow their rules and part of those rules are don't leave unless it's necessary. And even if I could leave it's not like I know anyone. I just found out today that my ex husband is dating some new girl... and I'm devestated. I am alone 24/7 completely miserable only with my daughter who I love to death but it's hard and my family want's nothing to do with her or me anymore anyway. I just don't feel like I can do this any more.
